blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large pretrained models such as CLIP are widely used as frozen feature extractors. However, their embeddings inherit spurious correlations from training data, introducing bias into the features. A growing body of research has sought to address this issue through post hoc debiasing, leaving the backbone untouched. We discover that despite differing mechanisms, these methods require the bias feature to be identified and expressed in text. This dependency is not innocuous. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that this requirement incurs an unforeseen penalty in certain scenarios. For example, on the UrbanCars benchmark, having two co-occurring bias attributes, the recent methods underperform a vanilla classifier on biased frozenbackbone features, and even providing ground-truth bias identities does not close the gap. We show that the pattern that such methods seek is readily observable in the frozen geometry. Specifically, cross-class training pairs placed closest together by the frozen encoder almost always share a spurious attribute, regardless of the bias type, without requiring access to the bias labels. Based on this, we propose a novel approach to identify such pairs and learn a single linear map that transforms the features to perform post-hoc debiasing. The proposed approach achieves competitive performance across all datasets without access to bias attribute annotations or any LLMs.
blocks.zh: CLIP等大型预训型号被广泛用作冷冻特性提取器. 然而,它们的嵌入从培训数据中继承了虚假的关联性,给特征引入了偏见. 越来越多的研究试图通过事后调离来解决这一问题,使骨干不受影响。 我们发现,尽管有不同的机制,这些方法需要确定偏差特征,并在案文中加以表述。 这种依赖性并非无害。 在这项工作中,我们实验性地证明,这一要求在某些情况下会造成意外处罚。 例如,在 " UrbanCars " 基准上,由于具有两个共同发生的偏差属性,最近的方法在偏差的冷冻后骨特征上使香草分级器表现不佳,甚至提供地真相偏差特性也无法弥补差距。 我们显示,这些方法所寻求的模式在被冻结的几何学中是很容易看到的。 具体地说,被被冷冻编码器放得最相近的跨级训练对几乎总是有一个虚假的属性,无论偏差类型如何,而不需要访问偏差标签. 在此基础上,我们提出了一种新颖的方法来识别这种对子,并学习一个单一的线性地图来改变特征来进行hoc后分解. 拟议办法在所有数据集中实现竞争业绩,没有偏见属性说明或任何有限责任管理。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large pretrained models such as CLIP [ 12 ] are widely used as frozen feature extractors. While classifiers built on the embeddings of such models reach high average accuracy on multiple tasks, they often fail on a predictable subset of inputs. The root cause of these failures stems from the data distributions at both the pretraining and downstream stages. Since foundational models are trained on massive, uncurated web corpora, their learned feature spaces inherently capture and encode various naturally occurring ‘spurious correlations’ [ 9 , 16 , 17 , 20 , 18 , 15 ] . Consequently, when a spurious attribute strongly co-occurs with the class label, classifiers exploit this shortcut, making the model biased toward that attribute, e.g., with a majority of white dog and black cat images, the classifier exploits this color shortcut over complex class-defining features. Such classifiers will fail at test time, if this spurious correlation breaks.
blocks.zh: CLIP [12]等大型预训型号被广泛用作冷冻特性提取器. 虽然基于这种模型嵌入的分类器在多项任务上达到了高平均准确度,但它们往往在可预见的投入子集上失败. 造成这些故障的根本原因来自培训前阶段和下游阶段的数据分布。 由于基础模型都是关于庞大的,未经探究的网络公司的培训,因此其学习的特征空间内在地捕捉并编码了各种自然发生的 " 纯粹的关联 " [9、16、17、20、18、15]。 因此,当一个带有类标签的虚假属性强烈地同化时,分类者会利用这个快捷键,使模型偏向于这个属性,例如,大多数是白狗和黑猫图像,分类者会利用这个颜色快捷键来取代复杂的类定义特征. 如果这种虚假的关联中断,这种分类器在测试时会失败.

blocks.en: Post-hoc debiasing methods address this issue by adapting the learned representation while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen [ 2 , 1 , 10 ] . Despite differing implementations, they all require the spurious attribute to be identified beforehand. Earlier methods relied on practitioners to specify the spurious attribute and construct descriptive text prompts [ 2 ] , while recent works use LLMs to propose candidate bias attributes based solely on class names and generate controlled scene descriptions. These are used to suppress the corresponding text-aligned direction in the embedding space [ 1 , 10 ] . While this shift is typically framed as a transition toward unsupervised debiasing, it is more appropriately just a change of oracle. This fundamental dependency on external attribute specification makes these methods incapable of detecting or correcting a misidentified bias.
blocks.zh: hoc脱轨后的方法通过调整学到的表述方式来解决这一问题,同时使事先训练过的骨干被冻结[2, 1, 10]. 尽管执行工作各不相同,但它们都要求事先确定虚假的属性。 更早的方法依靠从业者来指定虚假属性并构建描述性文字提示[2],而最近的作品则使用LLMS来提出完全基于类名的候选偏差属性并生成受控场景描述. 这些用于压制嵌入空间中相应的文本对接方向 [1, 10]. 虽然这一转变通常被描述为向不受监督的去杠杆化过渡,但更合适的是只是神谕的改变. 这种对外部属性规格的根本依赖,使得这些方法无法发现或纠正被误认的偏差.

blocks.en: This reliance on text-based attribute identification introduces a critical failure mode when datasets contain complex or co-occurring shortcuts. While LLM-driven methods succeed when a single spurious attribute aligns cleanly with broad world knowledge, they struggle with multiple or non-intuitive attributes. On the UrbanCars benchmark [ 7 ] , which features two simultaneous spurious attributes (background and co-occurring object), methods that obtain their attribute from a language model perform worse than an undebiased linear classifier trained on the frozen embeddings. PRISM [ 10 ] reaches only 3.23 % 3.23\% worst-group accuracy with a trained linear head, compared to 38.71 % 38.71\% for the undebiased baseline.
blocks.zh: 这种对文本属性识别的依赖,在数据集包含复杂或共同发生的快捷键时引入了关键故障模式. 虽然LLM驱动的方法在单一的虚假属性与广泛的世界知识保持干净的吻合时成功,但它们与多或非直觉属性相抗衡. 在 UrbanCars 基准 [7] 上,该基准具有两个同时存在的假属性(背景和共发生对象),从语言模型中获取其属性的方法比在被冻结嵌入上训练的不带偏见的线性分类器表现更糟糕. PRISM [10] 使用训练有素的线性头最差组精度仅为3.23% 3.23%,而无偏差基线为38.71% 38.71%.

blocks.en: One might hypothesize that this failure stems merely from imprecise LLM-generated descriptions. To test this hypothesis, we perform an oracle experiment by supplying ground-truth description of the spurious attributes to these methods ( Sec. 4.2 ). The accuracy improves but remains below the undebiased baseline. This demonstrates that external bias identification is necessary for such methods but insufficient: suppressing multiple text-guided subspaces can remove essential class-discriminative semantics, damaging the representation more than the shortcuts it removes. Thus, prompt refinement cannot resolve this fundamental trade-off.
blocks.zh: 人们可能假设,这种失败仅仅是由LLM生成的不准确描述造成的。 为了检验这一假设,我们通过提供这些方法的虚假属性的地面真实描述来进行甲骨文实验(第4.2条)。 准确性有所提高,但仍低于公正基准。 这表明外部偏差识别对于这些方法是必要的,但还不够:压制多条文字制导子空间可以去除基本的阶级歧视语义,比它去掉的捷径更会损害代表. 因此,迅速改进不能解决这种根本取舍。

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose an alternative paradigm that operates directly on an intrinsic geometric signature of bias rather than on bias attribute specifications. We define a sample as bias-aligned if its spurious attribute agrees with the dominant spurious-label correlation in the training data, and bias-conflicting if it violates it. Consequently, a cross-class pair sharing the same spurious attribute necessarily consists of one bias-aligned and one bias-conflicting sample, a configuration we term a bias-sharing pair . We observe that in a biased frozen feature space, cross-class pairs exhibiting high cosine similarity are bias-sharing. Spurious correlation thus manifests geometrically as a localized blur along identifiable cross-class sample pairs. Detecting these pairs requires no text prompts or attribute supervision, only class labels and pairwise similarity. By pulling apart these confusable cross-class pairs while maintaining the intra-class cohesion, we learn a single metric transformation 𝐖 ∈ ℝ d × d \mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d} over the frozen embeddings. Because this geometric criterion relies strictly on feature similarity, it isolates and separates bias-sharing pairs agnostic to the number or nature of underlying shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些限制,我们提出一种其他范式,它直接以偏见的内在几何特征而不是偏见属性规格为对象。 我们把样本定义为:如果其虚假属性与培训数据中最主要的虚假标签关联一致,则其为偏差相适应;如果违反该特征,则其为偏差相冲突。 因此,一个共享相同虚假属性的跨类对子必然包括一个偏差对齐和一个偏差相冲突样本,我们称之为偏差对子的配置。 我们观察到,在一个偏颇的被冻结的地物空间中,表现出高同位素相似性的跨级对子是偏差共享. 因此,纯正的关联性在几何上表现为可识别的跨类样本对的局部模糊. 检测这些对子不需要文本提示或属性监督,只需要类标签和对等相似性. 通过拉开这些相容的跨类对并同时保持类内相容性,我们学习了在被冻结的嵌入上进行单一的度量转换 W → R d → d → mathbf{ W →in\ mathbb{ R}^{d\times d}. 由于这个几何标准严格依赖地物相似性,因此它隔离并分离出偏向共享对子与基础快捷键的数量或性质不可知.

blocks.en: Our proposed framework requires no bias attribute annotations, language models, auxiliary biased models, or backpropagation through the backbone. Across extensive evaluations, our approach achieves 81.18 % 81.18\% worst-joint accuracy on UrbanCars (compared to 61.29 % 61.29\% for the best competing method) while simultaneously improving overall accuracy. On BAR, our method delivers state-of-the-art worst-group accuracy across all bias-conflicting ratios. Finally, on BFFHQ, our performance scales dynamically with the availability of conflicting samples, outperforming static prompt-based baselines as conflicting data increases. The contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们拟议的框架不需要偏差属性说明、语言模型、辅助偏差模型,也不需要通过骨干进行反向传播。 通过广泛的评估,我们的方法实现了81.18%,81.18%,城市汽车最差联合精度(而最佳竞争方法为61.29%,61.29),同时提高了总体精度。 在BAR方面,我们的方法提供了所有偏见-冲突比率的最先进的最差群体准确性。 最后,在BFFHQ,随着数据相冲突的增加,我们的业绩可随着相互冲突的样本的提供而动态地衡量,优于静态即时基准。 这项工作的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We empirically demonstrate that post-hoc debiasing methods that obtain the spurious attribute from a language model fail on multi-shortcut datasets, performing worse than an undebiased linear classifier, and that supplying ground-truth text prompts does not close the gap. • We identify an intrinsic geometric signature of spurious correlation in frozen embedding spaces where cross-class feature pairs with high similarity are overwhelmingly bias-sharing and show it can be detected purely from pairwise cosine similarity. • We introduce an annotation-free post-hoc debiasing approach that does not rely on external attribute descriptions or language models. • We evaluate the proposed approach across diverse multimodal and vision-only backbones (including CLIP [ 12 ] , SigLIP [ 19 ] , and DINOv3 [ 14 ] ), achieving state-of-the-art worst-group performance on the multi-shortcut benchmark and competitive performance across single-shortcut benchmarks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: There is a growing body of work that involves debiasing deep learning models. In this section, we discuss existing works that perform bias mitigation under various settings. Robust training without group labels. When group annotations are available, distributionally robust optimization [ 13 ] and last-layer retraining on a group-balanced set [ 6 ] optimize worst-group accuracy directly. A larger body of work removes that requirement by inferring which samples are atypical: from the errors of a deliberately biased model [ 11 , 8 ] then reweighting against them. These methods are effective, but they assume that the encoder is trainable, and their inference of atypical samples rests on a representation that changes as training proceeds. Debiasing frozen vision–language embeddings. Various recent works debias pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) without updating their backbones, instead modifying the learned embedding space post-hoc. These methods are often described as annotation-free because they do not require per-sample annotations of the spurious attribute. However, this does not necessarily remove the need to identify the attribute itself. In practice, most existing methods need to be told which attribute is spurious, either by the practitioner or by a large language model.

Although it does not require attribute annotations per image, the bias attribute must be explicitly named, and prompts describing its values are used.

blocks.en: Bias attribute named by a language model. RoboShot [ 1 ] shifts the burden of specifying the bias attribute to an LLM, which proposes features that are helpful or harmful for a target class, which are then converted into embedding directions and used for projection. PRISM [ 10 ] similarly uses an LLM to propose candidate attributes, then generates controlled scene descriptions in which the class and attribute vary independently and learns a projection that is invariant to the resulting attributes. Its variant, PRISM-mini, replaces the learned projection with an orthogonal projection. These methods avoid manually specifying the bias attribute, but rely on an external model to identify candidate attributes.

blocks.en: 3 Problem Setting
blocks.zh: 3 问题设置

blocks.en:
Let each example in the dataset be a tuple ( x , y , a ) (x,y,a) , where x ∈ 𝒳 x\in\mathcal{X} is an image, y ∈ 𝒴 y\in\mathcal{Y} is its class label, and a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} is a latent bias attribute that is not causally related to y y . Under a biased training distribution P train ​ ( x , y , a ) P_{\text{train}}(x,y,a) , a a and y y are spuriously correlated. A sample x x is bias-aligned when the pair ( y , a ) (y,a) follows that spurious correlation and bias-conflicting when it violates it. Let bias-ratio ρ \rho refer to the proportion of bias-conflicting samples in the dataset. A low ρ \rho denotes more biased dataset.
A dataset may carry multiple bias attributes at once. We consider a setting where each class has at least one spurious attribute value that appears in the majority of its samples. The same attribute value may appear in other classes, but only in the minority of their samples. Multiple such attributes may exist for a single class. In this setting, two samples of different classes that take the same value of a a are necessarily one aligned and one conflicting, since the majority value for one class can only be a minority value for the other. We call such a pair bias-sharing . Bias-sharing pairs are the ones a classifier is most likely to confuse. They agree on the bias attribute that the training correlation rewards and disagree on the class label.
We seek a classifier that performs well under a target distribution P test P_{\text{test}} in which the spurious correlation is absent, and in particular perform well on the conflicting groups, where reliance on the bias attribute a a is penalized rather than being rewarded. The performance is therefore measured by worst-group accuracy alongside the overall accuracy.
In this work, we limit the problem setting to classifiers built on a frozen large pretrained vision encoder f I f_{I} producing normalized embeddings 𝐱 = f I ​ ( x ) \mathbf{x}=f_{I}(x) . The encoder is not fine-tuned or trained on the biased dataset. The objective is to learn a map applied to those embeddings, together with a linear head. We operate in the bias-unaware setting, where the bias attribute a a is neither observed during training nor identified in advance.

blocks.en: 4 Motivation
blocks.zh: 4. 动机

blocks.en: Post-hoc debiasing methods that rectify a frozen embedding space require the spurious attribute to be specified before they can act. Multiple such methods obtain this specification from a language model, which proposes candidates from class names alone. This section examines the impact of that requirement on a more realistic UrbanCars benchmark, where two spurious attributes are present at once.

blocks.en: 4.1 Debiasing Performs Below the Baseline
blocks.zh: 4.1 低于基线的Debiasing表演

blocks.en: One might expect rectifying a biased representation to always help. Yet, we observe something strange on the UrbanCars benchmark ( Fig. 1 ). A linear classifier trained on features from a frozen pretrained model, with no debiasing, reaches 81.18 % 81.18\% overall and 38.71 % 38.71\% worst group accuracy. However, when we debias the features using post-hoc debiasing methods that use LLMs for bias-attribute specifications and train a same-capacity linear classifier on the debiased features, these methods perform very poorly. PRISM [ 10 ] reaches 3.23 % 3.23\% worst-group accuracy, RoboShot [ 1 ] reaches 8.06 % 8.06\% , and PRISM-mini [ 10 ] reaches 11.29 % 11.29\% . Even the best method falls 27 27 points below the naive classifier with no debiasing. Overall accuracy also declines, ruling out a robustness–accuracy trade-off.

blocks.en: 4.2 Expert Bias Specification Is Not Enough
blocks.zh: 4.2 专家偏见规格不足

blocks.en: Two competing explanations could account for the above failure. Firstly, LLM generated bias-specifications may not match the actual shortcuts. Secondly, the bias removal mechanism may be at fault. UrbanCars provides a direct test because it contains two co-occurring bias-shortcuts. We test the first explanation by replacing the LLM proposals with expert-written prompts that name the two ground-truth attributes, background and co-occurring object. Keeping the rest of the method same, we report the new results (+oracle) in Tab. 2 . Using a cosine classifier, PRISM improves from 1.61 % 1.61\% to 30.65 % 30.65\% on worst joint accuracy with the oracle information. With a trained linear head, the improvement is smaller, from 3.23 % 3.23\% to 17.74 % 17.74\% . The performance never reaches the 38.71 % 38.71\% of the undebiased linear classifier. Since the ground truth specification helps in both cases, the specifications were indeed part of the problem. But the ground truth specification is insufficient to beat the baseline. A likely reason is that the two bias shortcuts do not occupy orthogonal subspaces in the frozen embedding space. If we represent each spurious attribute as the text derived direction of its prompt, excluding the class component they share by construction, the cosine similarity between these two directions is 0.58 0.58 . PRISM removes the direction associated with a specified attribute. When two directions overlap this much, removing one leaves part of the other behind, and the classifier shifts its reliance to that residual. Fixing one bias makes the other worse. This is the whac-a-mole failure described in [ 7 ] , and UrbanCars was built to expose this.
blocks.zh: 两种相互矛盾的解释可以说明上述失败的原因。 首先,LLM产生的偏差规格可能与实际捷径不符. 第二,消除偏见机制可能存在缺陷。 城市 车厢提供直接测试,因为它包含两个共发偏差-短发. 我们测试第一个解释,将LLM提案取而代之的是专家撰写的提示,这些提示点出两个地面真实属性、背景和共同发生的物体。 保持其余方法不变,我们在Tab中报告新的结果(+oracle). 2,使用同位素分级器,PRISM在与甲骨文信息最差的联想精度上从1.61% 1.61%提高到30.65% 30.65%. 拥有训练有素的线性头部,改进幅度较小,从3.23% 3.23\%到17.74% 17.74\%. 性能从未达到无偏见线性分类器的38.71% 38.71%. 由于地面真相说明对这两种情况都有帮助,因此说明确实是问题的一部分。 但地面的真相说明不足以超越基线. 一个可能的原因是,两个偏差快捷键在被冻结的嵌入空间中不占用正向子空间. 如果我们代表每个虚假的属性,作为文字衍生出它的快取方向,不包括它们通过构造而共有的类成分,那么这两个方向的同位素相似性为0.58 0.58. PISM 取消了与指定属性相关的方向 。 当两个方向重叠了这么多时,去掉一个留下了另一个方向的一部分,分类者将其依赖性转移到了那个剩余部分. 纠正一种偏见会使另一种情况更糟。 这是[7]中描述的鲸-a-mole失败,而"Urban Cars"是用来揭露这一点的.

blocks.en: UrbanCars also exposes why the bias specification failed. Since an LLM proposes bias attributes for the given classes based on real-world co-occurrence priors, natural associations such as a vehicle type appearing against a specific background, get easily identified. However, the second shortcut in UrbanCars was introduced via image composition, corresponding to no predominant natural world observation. LLMs have nothing to draw upon in this regard, leaving them blind to artifacts that are not well-explored.
blocks.zh: UrbanCars也揭露了偏见规格为何失败的原因. 由于LLM根据现实世界共同发生的前科为给定的班级提出偏差属性,因此,自然关联,如在特定背景下出现的车辆类型,很容易被识别出. 然而,UrbanCars的第二个捷径是通过图像构成引入的,这与没有占主导地位的自然世界观察相对应. 法学硕士在这方面没有什么可借鉴的,使他们对未充分开发的文物视而不见。

blocks.en: 4.3 Intrinsic Trace of Bias in the Feature Space Geometry
blocks.zh: 4.3 地貌空间几何学中的比斯内向跟踪

blocks.en: Prompt-based methods require bias specification because they treat the spurious attribute as an external semantic concept that must be described before it can be eliminated. However, the bias attribute also leaves an intrinsic geometric signature in the representation that can be precisely measured without requiring a semantic description
blocks.zh: 即时方法需要偏差规格,因为它们将假的属性视为一种外部语义概念,必须加以描述才能消除. 然而,偏差属性也留下了一种内在的几何特征,可以精确地测量而不需要语义描述.

blocks.en: In the frozen embedding space, two images in UrbanCars of the same class on the same background have a mean cosine similarity of 0.630 0.630 . We analyze the effect of changing one attribute at a time. Changing only the background reduces this similarity to 0.589 0.589 . Changing only the class while keeping the background same reduces it to 0.584 0.584 . Therefore, a change in spurious attribute reduces cosine similarity by almost the same amount as changing the class. Therefore, a cross-class bias-sharing pair of samples that have the same background, will be placed almost as close to each other as two same class samples, by the frozen encoder. We study this finding to discover a geometric signature of the bias.
blocks.zh: 在被冻结的嵌入空间中,同一种背景的同级的UrbanCars中,有两幅相片的中同位素相似度为0.630 0.630. 我们分析一次改变一个属性的效果. 只改变背景就可以将这种相似性降低到0.589 0.589。 只改变类,而保持背景不变,则将其降低到0.584 0.584 . 因此,假想属性的改变会减少同位素相似性,几乎等于改变类. 因此,一对具有相同背景的跨级偏差共享样本,将几乎和两个同级样本相近,由被冻结的编码器放置. 我们研究这个发现是为了发现偏差的几何特征.

blocks.en: The decision boundary depends on the pairs of samples the encoder places closest together, not on the average pair. We refer to the two spurious attributes in UrbanCars, background and co-occurring object, as shortcuts. A cross-class pair drawn at random shares neither shortcut in 81.9 % 81.9\% of cases, shares one in 17.2 % 17.2\% cases, and both in only 0.9 % 0.9\% cases. When we select only the pairs with high cosine similarity, this distribution reverses ( Tab. 3 ). Pairs sharing neither shortcut fall to 5.2 % 5.2\% , while pairs sharing both rise to 47.6 % 47.6\% , and pairs sharing atleast one shortcut rises to 94.8%, becoming the dominant configuration. Therefore, the pairs the encoder finds most confusable due to high similarity are almost always bias-sharing . The reversal strengthens as the similarity threshold increases ( Fig. 2 ). The proportion of selected pairs that share the background or the co-occurring object rises continuously with the cutoff. This is an intrinsic property of the decision boundary, not an artifact of a chosen threshold. Selection therefore requires no prior knowledge of which attribute makes a pair similar or of how many attributes are involved. It is a measurable property of the representation, and we can use this to learn a transformation that separates bias-sharing pairs to debias the features.
blocks.zh: 决定边界取决于编码器放置在一起最接近的样本的对子,而不是平均对子. 我们把UrbanCars中两个虚假属性,背景和共生对象,称为快捷键. 在81.9%的个案中,随机抽取的一对跨类配对既不是捷径,在81.9%的个案中,17.2%的个案中共享一对,在0.9%的个案中,共享一对. 当我们只选择有高余弦相近性的对时,这种分布反相(Tab. 3.). 共享的对等不降为5.2% 5.2分之分,而共享的对等均升为47.6% 47.6分之分,共享至少一个快捷方式升为94.8%,成为主导配置. 因此,编码器发现最相容的对子由于高度相似性而几乎总是偏好分享. 随着相似性阈值的增加(图2),这种倒转会加强。 共享背景或共同发生对象的选定对的比例随截取而持续上升。 这是决定边界的固有财产,而不是选定界限的文物。 因此,选择不需要事先知道哪个属性使一对属性类似,或涉及多少个属性。 它是代表物的可测量属性,我们可以利用它来学习一种将偏分相对去除特征的转变.

blocks.en: 5 Proposed Approach
blocks.zh: 5 拟议办法

blocks.en: The analysis in Section 4.3 revealed an intrinsic geometric property: the cross-class pairs that a frozen encoder finds most confusable (high cosine similarity) are almost all bias-sharing . We turn this observation into an objective for post-hoc debiasing. The proposed approach learns a linear map 𝐖 ∈ ℝ d × d \mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d} which transforms the features of the frozen pretrained encoder to debias them ( Fig. 3 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Bias-sharing pair selection
blocks.zh: 5.1 偏好共享配对选择

blocks.en:
Let 𝐱 i \mathbf{x}_{i} denote the frozen embedding of image i i produced by the pretrained encoder, and let y i y_{i} denote its class label. We consider pairs of training images ( i , j ) (i,j) and measure their cosine similarity as ⟨ 𝐱 i , 𝐱 j ⟩ \langle\mathbf{x}_{i},\mathbf{x}_{j}\rangle . Motivated by our findings in Sec. 4.3 , we present the following condition for selecting bias-sharing pairs from the cross-class pairs. 𝒫 = { ( i , j ) : y i ≠ y j , ⟨ 𝐱 i , 𝐱 j ⟩ > τ push } . \mathcal{P}=\big\{(i,j):y_{i}\neq y_{j},\;\langle\mathbf{x}_{i},\mathbf{x}_{j}\rangle>\tau_{\text{push}}\big\}. (1) As characterized in Tab. 3 , applying this threshold on the UrbanCars dataset yields a set 𝒫 \mathcal{P} where 94.8 % 94.8\% of the members are bias-sharing, compared to just 18.1 % 18.1\% in the unconstrained cross-class distribution. Because every pair in 𝒫 \mathcal{P} spans two distinct classes, an objective built solely on this set would leave the geometry within each individual class unconstrained. To anchor the intra-class representation, we sample a secondary set of distant same-class pairs: 𝒬 ⊆ { ( i , j ) : y i = y j , ⟨ 𝐱 i , 𝐱 j ⟩ < τ pull } , \mathcal{Q}\subseteq\big\{(i,j):y_{i}=y_{j},\;\langle\mathbf{x}_{i},\mathbf{x}_{j}\rangle<\tau_{\text{pull}}\big\}, (2) taking one partner per image and retaining | 𝒫 | / N |\mathcal{P}|/N pairs per class (N refers to the number of classes), so that the two sets contribute comparable numbers of pairs for balanced regularization. Since bias-conflicting samples constitute a severe minority of the data, the overwhelming majority of any given class is bias-aligned.
Consequently, the low-similarity regime of 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} predominantly captures natural intra-class variance among these abundant aligned samples. However, this set also captures the rare/minor instances where the spurious attribute itself differs (pairing an aligned sample with a conflicting one). Pulling these pairs together is highly beneficial, as it encourages invariance to the spurious attribute while preserving overall class cohesion. Therefore, while 𝒫 \mathcal{P} can be processed to actively separate the confusable cross-class pairs, 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} acts as a broad structural anchor that prevents the internal geometry of the classes from collapsing. We discuss the contribution of each set in ( Sec. 6.3 ). Both sets are computed once, from the frozen embeddings, before 𝐖 \mathbf{W} exists. Membership is fixed by the geometry measured in Sec. 4 rather than by the representation the method is producing.

blocks.en: 5.3 Overview and Inference
blocks.zh: 5.3 概况和推论

blocks.en: In the proposed approach, we initialize the linear map 𝐖 ∈ ℝ d × d \mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d} as an identity matrix, ensuring optimization begins from the encoder’s native geometry. It is the sole component that receives a gradient, introducing only d 2 ≈ 0.59 d^{2}\approx 0.59 M learnable parameters compared to the backbone’s ∼ 300 {\sim}300 M. After learning the projection, we fit a linear classifier on the training split while keeping 𝐖 \mathbf{W} fixed. Since the CLIP+linear-head baseline in Sec. 6.2 employs an identical head and training schedule on unprojected embeddings, the two setups differ exclusively by the presence of 𝐖 \mathbf{W} . The objective ℒ \mathcal{L} depends on 𝐖 \mathbf{W} only through cosine similarities between transformed embeddings, so 𝐖 \mathbf{W} ’s scale is irrelevant, and the optimization effectively learns a linear map that reshapes pairwise similarities in the frozen feature space. Performance gains come from the geometric objective guiding 𝐖 \mathbf{W} toward a more robust representation.

blocks.en: We evaluate on four benchmarks. UrbanCars [ 7 ] is a binary vehicle classification task constructed with two simultaneous shortcuts, image background (BG), and a co-occurring object (CoObj). BAR [ 11 ] is a six-class action recognition task in which each action co-occurs with a typical place, evaluated at bias ratios ρ = \rho= 1% and 5%. BFFHQ [ 4 , 5 ] is an age classification task with a demographic shortcut, evaluated at ρ = \rho= 0.5%, 1%, 2%, and 5%. Waterbirds [ 13 ] is a bird classification task with a background shortcut, evaluated at ρ = \rho= 5%.

Worst Joint is the quantity that multiple shortcuts affect directly. Hyperparameters are selected per dataset on a held-out validation split, and test results are reported for the selected configuration. We run each experiment with three random seeds and report the mean and standard deviation. Further implementation details are provided in the supplementary materials.

blocks.en: On the UrbanCars benchmark, every method that obtains its attribute from an LLM falls below the undebiased linear classifier on all four metrics ( Tab. 4 ). Our method achieves 81.18 % 81.18\% Worst Joint accuracy, outperforming the best competing method by 19.89 19.89 points and CLIP-linear by 42.47 42.47 points. The gap between overall and Worst Joint accuracy shrinks from 45.16 45.16 points for the baseline to 9.41 9.41 points for our method, while overall accuracy improves from 81.18 % 81.18\% to 90.59 % 90.59\% . Unlike text-based baselines, our method also applies to vision-only backbones such as DINOv3. We report these results in the supplementary materials.

blocks.en: Our objective combines two forces. The first separates bias-sharing cross-class pairs ( ℒ push \mathcal{L}_{\text{push}} ), and the second maintains same-class cohesion ( ℒ pull \mathcal{L}_{\text{pull}} ). Tab. 6 shows that both are necessary. Removing either term drops Worst Joint accuracy by at least 22.58 22.58 points. The margins prevent unbounded optimization and add a further 4.84 4.84 points on top of the full objective. Fig. 4 Sweeps the two thresholds on UrbanCars. We use four random margin values for each threshold pair and average the results, reporting the mean and standard deviation. blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that debiasing a frozen encoder need not require explicit spurious-attribute identification. The bias signal is already encoded in the frozen feature geometry. Highly similar cross-class pairs are overwhelmingly bias-sharing, and this is detectable from pairwise similarity and class labels alone. Our method turns this observation into a training objective that separates bias-sharing pairs and maintains same-class cohesion. It consistently outperforms post-hoc debiasing approaches, including on the multi-bias benchmark, where methods dependent on LLM-generated specifications underperform an undebiased linear classifier.

blocks.en: The oracle experiment replaces the attributes that a language model proposes with an expert-written specification of the two shortcuts UrbanCars contains, leaving every other part of PRISM and PRISM-mini approaches unchanged. The specification names the background and the co-occurring object and enumerates the values each takes. The two methods consume it differently. PRISM generates scene descriptions from the specification and learns a projection under which descriptions differing only in an attribute become indistinguishable. Therefore, what it receives is a set of sentences. PRISM-mini trains nothing and directly builds its orthogonal projection from the attribute directions. Therefore, it receives only the values of the bias attributes, not descriptions.

blocks.en: 5.2 Where conflicting samples move
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 冲突样品移动的地方

blocks.en: The main paper showed that baseline finds it difficult to identify bias-conflicting samples relative to the class boundary. Projecting the embeddings onto the plane spanned by the class direction and the background direction makes that position visible ( Fig. 9 ). Both directions are differences of group means computed after training, and the background direction is orthogonalized against the class direction so that the two axes are not redundant, and neither enters the objective. In the frozen space, a conflicting sample sits on average 47 % 47\% of the way toward the opposing class along the class direction. Therefore, many of these samples shift to the wrong side of a boundary fitted to the majority. After projection, the same measurement gives 11 % 11\% . The plane retains two of 768 768 dimensions and is shown for interpretation, and the similarity measurements above are computed in the full space.
